alex_k: Quick Q — /v2/analyze is returning `warnings: null` in some responses and omitting `warnings` in others. Node SDK treats missing vs null differently (undefined vs null) and our frontend code branches on that. Should we standardize to always omit optional arrays/objects when empty, or always include them as null/empty? I don’t want to ship a change that breaks old clients.

maria_d: my vote: omit when empty for smaller payloads. Consumers should treat absent==empty. But we need explicit guidance in the API docs + a compatibility note.

sam_t: fwiw there’s also a Content-Type wrinkle — some older clients choke on `application/json; charset=utf-8` vs exactly `application/json`. We normalize in the SDK, but third-party clients still hit it. Could we add a `schemaVersion` top-level field so clients can opt into strict parsing? e.g. \"schemaVersion\": \"2026-03-01\" 

alex_k: example responses to make it concrete:
```json
// case A (current hosted responses)
{
  \"id\": \"r_123\",
  \"result\": { \"score\": 0.92 },
  \"warnings\": null,
  \"schemaVersion\": \"2026-01-15\"
}

// case B (older flow)
{
  \"id\": \"r_124\",
  \"result\": { \"score\": 0.81 }
  // no warnings key at all
}
```

maria_d: Thanks — if we standardize on omit, we should add a short note in the response section: \"Optional objects/arrays will be omitted when empty; clients should treat missing keys as empty/absent.\" Also add a small snippet for Node/TS: `const warnings = resp.warnings ?? []`

sam_t: Another operational suggestion: implement a canary header `X-API-SCHEMA: v2-preview` and only send `warnings: []` when header present. That gives us a rollout path without changing default behavior.

ingest-bot: registry: schema /v2/analyze revised -> rev 13 (nullable->omitted guidance). Deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T09:14:22Z.

jen_r: Action items I propose:
1) Docs update: add explicit note about omitted optional fields + code snippets (owner: maria_d)
2) SDKs: normalize Content-Type parsing (owner: sam_t)
3) Canary: implement `X-API-SCHEMA` preview + return `warnings: []` when set (owner: alex_k)
4) Telemetry: add a metric counting responses with missing vs null `warnings` (owner: eng-metrics)

alex_k: sounds good. I’ll open a small PR to add the header-based canary and the schemaVersion bump. Will ping once ready for a quick review.

maria_d: +1. I’ll draft the docs blurb and include the `const warnings = resp.warnings ?? []` example for JS and `resp.warnings.getOrElse(Nil)` for Scala.

sam_t: I’ll add Content-Type tolerant parsing to the Node SDK today and include tests for `application/json; charset=utf-8` and `application/json`.

jen_r: Leaving this here so it’s searchable — thanks folks. :thumbsup:
